notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 78 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

refinement.note: Sparse paired native-image edge readings reconstruct the west-side chicane independently of source normals, followed by six source-normal readings of the straight inner edge and one opposite edge reading. The asphalt side of visible white curbs and the approximate pavement/shoulder transition are used; blur, scene seams and georegistration remain uncertain, with roughly metre-level reading precision rather than survey accuracy. All intervals interpolate, and preserved seed endpoints and shared-paving openings remain inferred joins, not independent observations. Original source trace and timing are retained. Curbs are illustrative, banking unknown and terrain approximate. Additional negative-side pavement/shoulder reads at20,35,50,65,80,95 and1160,1175,1190,1205,1220 replace internal-patch false edges. Existing opposite points at65 and1190 are retained after visual confirmation; other seed anchors and open paved junctions remain estimated.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. The source centreline was checked against this image; candidate edges must bracket its smoothed cross-sections. This opt-in constraint does not set a road width or establish positional accuracy. It is unsuitable for an unaligned source trace. Sparse edge anchors measured on the pinned image correct the documented sections. Evidence scores describe the original automatic proposal, not the corrected borders. The seed and final border hashes and correction recipe are retained.
